title: Shared version bump — Windows fixes; Mac unchanged
highlights: Version-only bump so Mac and Windows stay on the same release number — no behavioral change on the Mac side.
Windows: clipboard sync survives the app going to tray (Win32 sequence-number polling replaces the foreground-only UWP event).
Windows: Dashboard latency shows a real value again — fixed a PeerSession rekey bug that was silently dropping every RTT update.
Windows: hero card link-state border + tighter card padding, closer to the Mac visual language.
